=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/semble_helpers.sh
Line or code reference: lines 4-15 (the `_semble_log_event` function body after the diff)
Problem: The PR removes the `SEMBLE_LOG_CONTEXT` auto-appending logic from `_semble_log_event`. The function no longer checks for the env var and no longer emits a `context=` field when it is set.
Why it fails at runtime: `tests/test_semble_helpers.py` at lines 99, 120, and 152 asserts `"context=contract-test" in result.stderr`. That test sets `SEMBLE_LOG_CONTEXT="contract-test"` (line 35) and was passing on HEAD~1. After this PR, the production code no longer emits the `context=` field, so all three assertions will fail with `AssertionError`. The test file itself is not modified in this PR.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/targeted_file_context.py
Line or code reference: lines 149-154 (the `_log_semble_event` function and removed `_normalized_semble_log_context` helper)
Problem: The PR removes `_normalized_semble_log_context()` and the context-auto-appending logic from `_log_semble_event`. The function was introduced by sibling PR #3224 (commit `66a225c`) to normalize `SEMBLE_LOG_CONTEXT` and inject it as a `context=` field in Semble telemetry output.
Why it fails at runtime: `tests/test_targeted_file_context.py` at lines 395 and 532 asserts `"context=contract-test" in telemetry`. The test sets `SEMBLE_LOG_CONTEXT="contract-test"` (line 39) and was passing on HEAD~1. After this PR removes the context injection, both assertions will fail. The test file is not modified in this PR.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Stay inside the `files_touched` list" (issue #3232 implementer notes)
Expected change site: The diff hunks in `scripts/semble_helpers.sh`, `scripts/targeted_file_context.py`, and `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt`
Evidence of absence: Issue #3232 scope is: (1) append a section for `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-08.md` to `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`, (2) delete only `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-08.md`. The PR additionally modifies `scripts/semble_helpers.sh` (removing 13 lines), `scripts/targeted_file_context.py` (removing 15 lines), and `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` (adding 1 line for `tests/test_phase_skip_gate_telemetry_contract.py`). None of these three files is within the issue's stated scope. The SEMBLE_LOG_CONTEXT removal specifically reverts production code introduced by sibling PR #3224, breaking tests that the sibling PR added.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
